name: Vitre Tray
description: Keeps a tray item that is gone before its icon loads (an app's second launch that loses the single-instance lock and quits, for example Claude's) from flashing a loading glyph in the top bar and from logging warnings. A new tray button stays hidden until its icon has loaded, or for at most 1.5 s. Works on top of Ubuntu AppIndicators; disabling puts everything back.
